Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

We totally get worrying about choosing the wrong thing—there’s a lot to consider for your pup.

Here’s how we help you pick the right Nom Nom setup:

Specific needs or medical issues: We recommend talking with your vet first, especially if your dog has kidney disease, liver disease, pancreatitis, or urinary stones. We don’t offer prescription, low-fat, low-sodium, or hydrolyzed recipes, so your vet’s guidance is key.
Custom portions: When you set up your dog’s profile, we use their age, weight, ideal weight, and activity level (Average, Active, or Athlete) to tailor portions just for them.
Activity level choices:
Average: ~1 hour of daily activity
Active: 2+ hours of daily activity
Athlete: 3+ hours of intense daily activity
Ongoing clarity: Once your plan is set, your dog’s exact recipes and portion sizes live in your online account. On the Pets page you can always see what to feed, and use the “View Feeding Guide” link for up‑to‑date, step‑by‑step feeding instructions.
Price clarity if you’re also worried about cost: Your price depends on your dog’s details (number of dogs, ages, current/ideal weights, activity levels, zip code, and recipes you pick), so we build it around your pup rather than a one‑size‑fits‑all price.

So yes, we can absolutely help you choose wisely. If you tell us about your dog’s age, weight, activity level, and any health concerns your vet has mentioned, we’ll be able to point you toward a setup that better fits their needs.

Totally get that—when you’ve been let down before, you want proof, not promises.

Here’s what we do for quality:

Vet-designed & balanced: Recipes are formulated and scientifically evaluated by veterinary nutritionists and our PhD science team, plus a custom Nutrient Mix in every meal.
Careful cooking: Each ingredient is gently cooked separately to boost digestibility and nutrition, not raw and not ultra-processed like kibble.
Strict ingredient checks: We inspect every ingredient and rigorously test for safety and quality before it goes into our kitchens.
Our own kitchens: Meals are prepared and packaged in our facilities in Nashville, TN and the San Francisco Bay Area, so we control the process end to end.
All life stages: Formulated to support puppies through seniors, with portions adjusted as your pup grows and their metabolism changes.
Planet-conscious packaging: Boxes and insulated liners are recyclable or made from recycled materials, and we use dry ice which is more eco-friendly and keeps food colder longer.

So in a nutshell, we build quality in at every step—from recipe science to cooking, testing, and packaging—to avoid the kind of disappointments you’ve had with other brands.
